name: design-bites
summary: 270+ DESIGN.md files auto-extracted from well-designed websites, installed into a project with one CLI command.
description: Curated DESIGN.md files that encode a website's visual language in markdown for AI agents: colors, typography, spacing, shadows, borders, components, content structure and site-specific do's and don'ts, in a 9-section standard format. Files are auto-extracted from live sites by a two-step pipeline (Playwright CSS extraction, then Claude analysis) and can be installed with a zero-dependency Node CLI, copied from the repo, or browsed on Sparkbites.
contains: 270+ design systems auto-extracted from live websites
